note: The launch contract's one policy (host runtime spec v0.5 R6.7-d), read by the delegation runner, the two front-door connections, the fixed-send probe and, later, the fallback door. launch_env.py reads and checks it; launch.py applies its pins, checks, routes and records. Its SHA-256 goes into every launch record (LCH-6). Names only: no value of any kind is ever written here or in anything built from it. Changing a list is a reviewed change of this file, recorded by its new digest.

base.name: PATH
base.reason: Claude Code reads its plan sign-in by running `security find-generic-password` by name; both CLIs' shell tools find programs with it.

base.name: HOME
base.reason: Claude Code's ~/.claude and the login Keychain; Codex's CODEX_HOME defaults to ~/.codex (auth.json). Inherited from the parent only: as an extra it would move the CLI's sign-in and settings, so a deny pattern refuses it there (deny_overrides).

base.name: LANG
base.reason: the locale of the commands they run. The connections also pass LANG as an extra.

base.name: LC_ALL
base.reason: the locale of the commands they run.

base.name: TERM
base.reason: terminal handling only, harmless without a terminal; kept so the runner's list is unchanged.

base.name: TMPDIR
base.reason: the runtime's temporary folder (Claude Code's runtime: TMPDIR, else /tmp); Codex adds it to its sandbox's writable roots.

base.name: USER
base.reason: the Keychain account Claude Code reads the plan sign-in under (USER, else the OS user name).

base.name: SHELL
base.reason: the shell Claude Code's Bash tool and Codex's command runner start.

extras.name: MINIMOI_AGENT_REQUESTS_DIR
extras.reason: a connection's own ledger folder, a path and not a credential: the ledger helper (scripts/agent_requests.py) falls back to it when a command has no --root, so the session never reaches the global default ledger

extras.name: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER
extras.reason: Claude Code: the pinned CLI never replaces itself (the CLI reads it; the installed connection plist set it to 1)

extras.name: LANG
extras.reason: a UTF-8 locale (en_US.UTF-8) for the agents and the commands they run. Under launchd the manager has no LANG; Python's locale coercion (PEP 538) gave it LC_CTYPE=C.UTF-8, which the whole-environment copy used to pass on. The fixed sender and the Codex read observer set the same value.

extras.name: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT
extras.reason: the delegation runner's git never waits on a credential prompt (value 0)

unattended.note: Runtime items and the front-door connections (R6.7-d). The base list plus reviewed exact names. No credential name at all, no SSH_AUTH_SOCK, no push (R4.5-c).

supervised.note: The fallback door, with Robert present (R6.7-d, R6.7-i). Also his own git agent, his terminal and locale names and his editors, so his own git use works. Still no provider key and no token.

inherit.name: SSH_AUTH_SOCK
inherit.reason: Robert's own git over ssh, with him present

inherit.name: LOGNAME
inherit.reason: the login name his own tools read

inherit.name: TERM_PROGRAM
inherit.reason: terminal handling for an interactive session

inherit.name: TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION
inherit.reason: terminal handling for an interactive session

inherit.name: COLORTERM
inherit.reason: terminal colour support for an interactive session

inherit.name: __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING
inherit.reason: macOS text encoding for an interactive session

inherit.name: EDITOR
inherit.reason: his editor, for git commit messages

inherit.name: VISUAL
inherit.reason: his editor, for git commit messages

deny_overrides.name: MINIMOI_AGENT_REQUESTS_DIR
deny_overrides.reason: matches ^MINIMOI_ but is a ledger folder path, never a credential (R6.7-d's own example: claude_stream.py against workspace.py)

deny_overrides.name: HOME
deny_overrides.reason: a base name, copied from the parent only; ^HOME$ exists so that no caller can move it as an extra

deny_overrides.name: SSH_AUTH_SOCK
deny_overrides.reason: Robert's own ssh agent, with him present (the supervised profile only; never unattended)

claude-code.subscription.note: Claude Code on Robert's plan sign-in (usd_notional, not a bill).

codex.subscription.note: Codex on the ChatGPT plan (deadline only).

anthropic.api.note: Unqualified (R4.5-d, R6.7-f, N5): whether a key given to Claude Code reaches its tool processes, or a key helper keeps it out, is not shown.

openai.api.note: Unqualified (R4.5-d, R6.7-f, N5): the key's reach inside Codex is not shown.

fakework.subscription.note: T11b's test subscription route, configured supervised-only at the authority.

fakework.plan.note: T19a-d's test subscription route that the authority admits unattended (the T11b route stays supervised-only).

fakework.api.note: T19e's test API route. Qualified by R6.7-f's third way: fakework runs no tool process and no shell, so the key reaches nothing beyond its own process.

fakejudge.note: MC's judgment stand-in (T16): reserved at the authority, never launched as a tool.

grok.note: No adapter is built and Grok is stopped (R6.5). The sign-in file and auth_mode are R6.7-e's; config.toml is the file in ~/.grok; its key names are R6.7-d's, unverified against the installed grok (N5).

fakework.note: The bundle's own fakework/1, run by the pinned interpreter (its digest is the bundle's). No sign-in and no configuration, so a subscription route refuses it (signin_missing).

fakecli.note: A fakework/1 build packaged like a vendor CLI (§9.3), with its own sign-in file and user and project configuration. A host runs it for actor fakework when host.yaml pins it.
